cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(SingleEditorImportEvidenceFixture LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT MSVC OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "This retained import evidence fixture requires MSVC x64")
endif()
add_library(SingleEditorImportFixtureLibrary SHARED library.cpp library.def)
add_executable(SingleEditorImportFixture main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SingleEditorImportFixture PRIVATE SingleEditorImportFixtureLibrary delayimp)
target_link_options(SingleEditorImportFixture PRIVATE /DELAYLOAD:SingleEditorImportFixtureLibrary.dll /DELAY:UNLOAD)
